personal_info.title: Flutter Developer
personal_info.summary: Flutter developer with 3+ years of experience building cross-platform mobile applications. Skilled in clean architecture, state management, REST API integration, and real-time communication with WebSocket.

responsibilities: Improved mobile application by delivering new features and optimizing performance
Designed and implemented a real-time chat system using WebSocket
Ensured smooth, crash-free operation of the application
Implemented invoice creation and product management features
Optimized API requests across the app to remove redundancies
Improved performance and ensured efficient data handling
Built a mobile app to promote the tourism sector
Introduced tourists to key attractions of Uzbekistan
Worked on a large dynamic ERP project with multiple modules
Developed Accounting, HR, Sales, Payroll, Project Management, and BI modules
Participated in App Store and Play Market deployment processes
Gained extensive experience in mobile app development lifecycle
Fixed bugs in several mobile applications
Learned core principles of the Flutter framework and Dart language

projects.description: Joined the project after the initial development phase and optimized its performance by around 40%. Improved app stability, fixed bugs, and implemented full dark & light mode support.

An ERP system with multiple modules such as Project Management, Accounting, and Sales. Worked primarily on the Project Management and Home sections, focusing on modular UI development and state management.

A lightweight mobile app designed for tourists to explore and discover nearby attractions and points of interest. Built with an emphasis on simple navigation and responsive UI for better travel usability.
Initially worked on fixing bugs in the old version. Later rewrote the project from scratch using modern technologies due to outdated architecture. The project completed one full development cycle.
Worked mainly on bug fixing and learned how to deploy apps to both the App Store and Play Market. Improved app stability and performance during maintenance updates.
